TABLE.NAME: local_vikesa_institution
TABLE.COMMENT: Maps a Casdoor institution to its Moodle category and its fixed 'responsible' (always-Teacher) jobtitle

FIELD.NAME: institution
FIELD.COMMENT: Exact institution string as sent by Casdoor

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course_categories.id this institution's courses live under

FIELD.NAME: responsiblejobtitle
FIELD.COMMENT: Jobtitle value that always grants Teacher + course-creation rights in this institution's category

FIELD.NAME: logourl
FIELD.COMMENT: Org logo URL pulled from Casdoor

FIELD.NAME: faviconurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Org favicon URL pulled from Casdoor

TABLE.NAME: local_vikesa_usersync
TABLE.COMMENT: Last synced institution/jobtitle per user, so the observer/task can diff and move cohort membership on change

TABLE.NAME: local_vikesa_course_meta
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-course metadata not captured by core: currently just the renewal period for periodical courses

FIELD.NAME: renewalmonths
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated, superseded by renewalvalue+renewalunit. Kept for old data, no longer written.

FIELD.NAME: renewalvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: NULL = one-off course. Paired with renewalunit: how long after a user's completion date before they're due again.

FIELD.NAME: renewalunit
FIELD.COMMENT: One of: day, week, month, year.
